Package org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.logicprogrammer

Class ExpressionPanelRendering

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.logicprogrammer.ExpressionPanelRendering
public final class ExpressionPanelRendering extends Object
The layout, colors and drawing that the expression panel of an operator and the one without an operator share.

      public static void renderStatus(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics guiGraphics, int guiLeft, int guiTop, net.minecraft.client.gui.Font font, Expression expression, ExpressionTypeChecker.Result result, List<ExpressionPanelRendering.Region> regions)
      Draw the type of the expression in the footer, in the colors of its types as in tooltips, or the first error instead, which keeps it from being written. The check mark next to the operator name already tells when it can be written.

    • renderFooter

      public static void renderFooter(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics guiGraphics, int guiLeft, int guiTop, net.minecraft.client.gui.Font font, net.minecraft.network.chat.Component text, @Nullable net.minecraft.network.chat.Component tooltip, List<ExpressionPanelRendering.Region> regions)
      Draw text centered in the footer, on the dark background of the expression where the colors of types are readable. Text that does not fit ends in an ellipsis.

      regions - Where the region for the tooltip is added.
